method: Supplemental descriptive technical-score diagnostics; all 100 controlled families remain in the original analysis. Blind categorical stimulus reviews select additional comparisons, never numeric labels. A comparison is verified only for clear_degradation. Parent comparisons, severe-versus-parent comparisons and fully verified adjacent ladders have separate denominators. Positive mean drop is comparison technical score minus derivative technical score. Native precision is retained; absolute differences <=1e-8 are ties. Exact (1,1) floor pairs are reported separately and can be policy-correct for art/nonphotographic content; neither ties nor every severe score at least as high as its parent is automatically an error. No aesthetic monotonicity is required. This is not PACE ground-truth-threshold Holistic Override Rate.
